Calendar

A calendar component that allows users to select a date or a range of dates.

Oct 2026
Su Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa 
																			<Calendar SelectedDate="_overviewDate" SelectedDateChanged="OnOverviewDateChanged" CaptionLayout="dropdown" Rounded="Rounded.Lg" Border="Border.Default" />

Persian / Hijri / Jalali Calendar

Calendar supports right-to-left Persian date formatting.
خرداد ۱۴۰۴
Sa Su Mo Tu We Th Fr 
																			<DirectionProvider Dir="rtl">     <Calendar SelectedDate="_persianDate" SelectedDateChanged="OnPersianDateChanged" DisplayMonth="_persianDisplayMonth" CultureName="fa-IR" UseCultureCalendar="true" FixedWeeks="true" Class="[--cell-size:--spacing(8)]" Rounded="Rounded.Lg" Border="Border.Default" Padding="Padding.Is3"/> </DirectionProvider>

Basic

A basic calendar component styled with a rounded border.
May 2026
Su Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa 
																			<Calendar SelectedDate="_basicDate" SelectedDateChanged="OnBasicDateChanged" DisplayMonth="_aprilDisplayMonth" Rounded="Rounded.Lg" Border="Border.Default" />

Range Calendar

Use range mode to enable range selection.
January 2026
Su Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa
February 2026
Su Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa 
																			<Card Margin="Margin.OnX.Auto" Width="Width.IsFit" Padding="Padding.Is0">     <CardBody Padding="Padding.Is0">         <Calendar Mode="CalendarSelectionMode.Range" DisplayMonth="_rangeDisplayMonth" SelectedRange="_selectedRange" SelectedRangeChanged="OnSelectedRangeChanged" NumberOfMonths="2"/>     </CardBody>

Month and Year Selector

Use month and year dropdowns for direct caption navigation.
May 2026
Su Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa 
																			<Calendar SelectedDate="_dropdownCaptionDate" SelectedDateChanged="OnDropdownCaptionDateChanged" CaptionLayout="dropdown" DisplayMonth="_aprilDisplayMonth" Rounded="Rounded.Lg" Border="Border.Default"/>

Presets

Preset actions can drive the selected date while keeping the calendar as the source of date selection.
May 2026
Su Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa 
																			<Card Margin="Margin.OnX.Auto" Width="Width.IsFit" MaxWidth='MaxWidth.Token("[300px]")'>     <CardBody>         <Calendar SelectedDate="_presetDate" SelectedDateChanged="OnPresetDateChanged" DisplayMonth="_aprilDisplayMonth" FixedWeeks="true" Class="[--cell-size:--spacing(9.5)]" Padding="Padding.Is0"/>     </CardBody>

Date and Time Picker

Use the date-time picker when the calendar selection needs a time value as well.
May 2026
Su Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa 
																			<Card CardSize="CardSize.Sm" Margin="Margin.OnX.Auto" Width="Width.IsFit">     <CardBody>         <Calendar SelectedDate="_calendarDate" SelectedDateChanged="OnCalendarDateChanged" DisplayMonth="_aprilDisplayMonth" Class="[--cell-size:--spacing(7)]" Padding="Padding.Is0"/>     </CardBody>

Booked dates

Use modifiers plus disabled dates to style and block already-booked days.
February 2026
Su Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa 
																			<Card Margin="Margin.OnX.Auto" Width="Width.IsFit" Padding="Padding.Is0">     <CardBody Padding="Padding.Is0">         <Calendar SelectedDate="_bookedDate" SelectedDateChanged="OnBookedDateChanged" DisplayMonth="_bookedDisplayMonth" DisabledDates="_bookedDates" Modifiers="@BookedModifiers" ModifierClasses="@BookedModifierClasses"/>     </CardBody>

Custom Cell Size

Customize day cells with additional content such as pricing or availability cues.
December 2026
Su Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa 
																			<Card Margin="Margin.OnX.Auto" Width="Width.IsFit" Padding="Padding.Is0">     <CardBody Padding="Padding.Is0">         <Calendar Mode="CalendarSelectionMode.Range" DisplayMonth="_customDayDisplayMonth" SelectedRange="_customDayRange" SelectedRangeChanged="OnCustomDayRangeChanged" CaptionLayout="dropdown" UseFullMonthNames="true" Class="[--cell-size:--spacing(10)] md:[--cell-size:--spacing(12)]" DayContent="@RenderPricingDay"/>     </CardBody>

Calendar supports right-to-left layouts with locale-aware formatting.
